_doc: Voice casting. 'pick' is the voice used by scripts/tts.py; 'candidates' are auditioned by the TTS workflow (samples land in audio/voices/samples/). engine: kokoro (Kokoro-82M, Apache-2.0) or piper (rhasspy piper voices, MIT/CC licences per voice).

adrian-cross.line: Relax, detective. If I wanted to kill someone, I'd have used a far more interesting method.

maya-reed.line: You were at the scene twelve minutes before the call came in. Explain that.

thomas-hayes.line: Thirty years on homicide, and I have never seen a crime scene this clean.

elias-voss.line: Every guest leaves something behind at my table. Usually it is the truth.

nora-vale.line: Three victims, one chess piece each. Tell me that's a coincidence and I'll print it.

leo-park.line: Okay, so, good news, I found prints! Bad news, they're, uh, mine.

narrator-hindi.line: Us raat sheher mein baarish ruki nahi, aur ek aur laash mili. Is baar bhi wahi kaala mohra.
